title: Ships Watch Vacation Rental
meta_description: Ships Watch is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionShip’s WatchSeaside Beach CommunityQuincy Circle, Seaside, FL 32459Home Highlights2 bedrooms (see “Room Details” tab above)2 full bathroomsSleeps 4 guestsApproximately 1,300 sq. ft.Spacious rooftop deck with sweeping Gulf viewsFull-sized washer and dryer3rd-floor unit—no elevator accessSeaside amenity fee appliesOverviewExperience the ultimate Seaside getaway at Ship’s Watch, a unique 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo perched above the new Onward Reserve store. Blending laid-back coastal charm with Onward Reserve’s signature adventurous style, this home offers masculine, refined décor with modern comforts. Vintage-inspired accents meet thoughtful design, creating a space that’s as stylish as it is inviting.Step onto the rooftop deck to soak in panoramic Gulf views—perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or stargazing after a day on the beach. Centrally located, Ship’s Watch puts you just steps from Seaside’s iconic shops, dining, and sandy beaches.Community Amenities (Additional Fee Applies)Multiple poolsPrivate beach accessSeaside Town Center: shops & restaurantsTennis, pickleball, fitness center, volleyball, playground, shuffleboardReservation & PoliciesNO SMOKINGPets not allowed (service animals excepted; documentation required)Published rates do not include tax and fees50% due at booking; balance due 60 days before arrival (or full payment if within 60 days)Cancellations more than 60 days prior receive full refund minus 5% processing feeOptional travel insurance available (must purchase before final payment)Check-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTGuests must be 25+ years oldBooking Note: The 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement overrides any third-party booking site policies (VRBO, HomeAway, etc.). Additional service fees from third-party sites are non-refundable.Book your stay at Ship’s Watch and enjoy the Onward Reserve experience in the heart of Seaside, where style, comfort, and the Gulf breeze come together perfectly.
